themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Spike in Sunset Park
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints surged to 5 reports this week compared to a 0.2-per-week average over the prior 8 weeks—a 1900% spike (z-score: 10.97)—marking the most statistically anomalous issue in the district and suggesting either a genuine public safety escalation or emerging open-air drug market.
evidence: 5 drug activity complaints this week vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1900% increase)
Z-score of 10.97 indicates extreme statistical deviation from baseline
Community Board budget requests include 'Expand street outreach' (Agency: Department of Homeless Services), suggesting prior concern about open-air conditions
reporting_angles: Map the five complaints geographically—are they clustered in specific blocks or dispersed? Interview NYPD and local precinct leadership about enforcement strategy.
Speak with residents in high-complaint blocks about visible drug use, timing of activity, and impact on foot traffic/safety perceptions.

themes_detail.label: Dead and Dying Trees Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints hit 9 reports this week versus a 1.2-per-week baseline over 8 weeks—a 620% spike (z-score: 5.57)—concurrent with a separate 554% surge in overgrown tree/branch complaints (9 last week vs. 1.4 avg), suggesting possible storm damage, disease outbreak, or neglected tree maintenance across the district.
evidence: 9 dead/dying tree complaints this week vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (620% increase, z-score: 5.57)
9 overgrown tree/branch complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average (554% increase, z-score: 4.84)
Community Board requests include 'Provide a new or expanded park or amenity' (Department of Parks and Recreation), indicating prior park/greenspace maintenance concerns
reporting_angles: Obtain Department of Parks tree inspection data for CD 307 over the past 30 days; identify species, locations, and stated causes of decline.
Interview Parks Department arborist about recent storm impacts or pest/disease activity; cross-reference with recent weather records for Brooklyn.

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 9 reports last week versus a 1.8-per-week baseline—a 414% spike (z-score: 6.05)—suggesting either deliberate vandalism, unpermitted pruning, or construction-related tree damage that warrants environmental enforcement investigation.
evidence: 9 illegal tree damage complaints last week vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (414% increase, z-score: 6.05)
660 DOB building permit filings in last 90 days (447 alterations, 64 new buildings) suggest active construction; permits may lack tree protection clauses
Concurrent with 'Dead/Dying Tree' spike, indicating possible chain-reaction damage from unpermitted work
reporting_angles: Cross-reference the 9 illegal tree damage complaints with active DOB permits in those same blocks; identify construction sites operating without tree protection.
Interview Parks Enforcement Patrol about enforcement against illegal pruning or construction violations; request fine/violation data for CD 307.

themes_detail.label: Boiler & Heating Emergencies Rising
themes_detail.summary: Boiler complaints surged to 3 reports this week versus a 0.5-per-week baseline—a 500% spike (z-score: 5.0)—occurring in tandem with 991 heat/hot water complaints across 90 days, indicating systemic winter heating failures that threaten tenant habitability.
evidence: 3 boiler complaints this week vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (500% increase, z-score: 5.0)
991 total heat/hot water complaints over 90 days (second-highest complaint category in district)
Community Board requests include 'Renovate or upgrade public housing developments' (Housing Authority), suggesting aging building stock vulnerability
reporting_angles: Identify buildings with multiple boiler/heat complaints this winter; interview tenants about duration and health impacts (elderly, children at risk).
FOIL HPD violation data for CD 307 on 'Lack of Heat' violations; determine if landlords are repeat offenders and what enforcement action HPD has taken.

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Complaints Quadruple
themes_detail.summary: Smoking or vaping complaints jumped to 4 reports this week versus a 0.9-per-week baseline—a 357% spike (z-score: 5.21)—suggesting possible new enforcement messaging, a specific hotspot (indoor/outdoor), or community reporting surge around a particular venue.
evidence: 4 smoking/vaping complaints this week vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (357% increase, z-score: 5.21)
No clear concurrent pattern in related health/indoor air quality 311 complaints
May indicate increased residential complaints around a specific building, venue, or outdoor public space
reporting_angles: Map the 4 complaints geographically; identify if clustered near a single building, school, or park.
Interview Community Board or Parks enforcement about recent anti-smoking outreach or new restaurant/bar enforcement focus.
